title: Esrbespoke hero
description: A full-window film hero on black: the video fills the window edge to edge, a two-line headline sits just above the middle at the left, a short note in tiny capitals at column 9, and a sound toggle and a story link along the bottom. On phones the note and link drop to a row just below the middle. The film sinks at a third of the scroll speed as the hero leaves (scrubbed parallax).
notes: always on the dark scope (white text over the film); the empty slot is a dark muted placeholder
parallax is CSS scroll-driven inside @supports and off under reduced motion
the sound button only calls onSound; wire it to your video
name: esrbespoke-hero

props.name: note
